rows.historical_evidence: Classic observation-to-instinct-to-QUEEN.md promotion evidence retained in 204-CLASSIC-HISTORICAL-EVIDENCE.md (OLD-01/OLD-02/OLD-03); 204-CLASSIC-SYNTHESIS.md ruling (c) confirms the ledger's restore-modern disposition is correct in direction -- observation capture (cmd/memory_feed.go's recordDispatchWorkerOutcome) was already fixed before this phase began, so the real remaining gap this phase closed is application-evidence richness: recordPhaseApplicationCredit is the credit ledger's first real production writer, deriving decision/effect identifiers from a phase's own durable build-attempt evidence rather than prompt delivery plus phase success.

Classic test-suite-run and test-file-census evidence retained in 204-CLASSIC-HISTORICAL-EVIDENCE.md; seven named budgeted gates (fast/focused/integration/provider/overnight/race/release) now tier the existing test corpus, each proving its own discovered-equals-executed count rather than the timeout-prone unqualified go test that this project's own audits caught silently truncating (SYN-204-08).

Classic skill-create evidence retained in 204-CLASSIC-HISTORICAL-EVIDENCE.md; ruling (d) corrects the plan's own draft assumption -- the default propose mode never silently created a skill, but it was a no-op with a stale comment, not owner-governed. Both propose and auto modes now raise the identical proposal into the owner's existing tick-to-approve queue (colony.PendingSuggestion); approving creates the skill, declining creates nothing.

Classic instinct-create-from-verified-phase-learnings evidence retained in 204-CLASSIC-HISTORICAL-EVIDENCE.md (OLD-02's unverified self-report); recordInstinctApplicationsForPhase now derives each application's outcome from the real, evidence-gated credit record rather than recording success:true unconditionally on every durably-advanced phase, giving the negative branch Classic's own honour-system mechanism never independently verified.

Classic pheromone-decay-and-expiry evidence retained in 204-CLASSIC-HISTORICAL-EVIDENCE.md (mechanism 6): Classic's own eternal-promotion gate was never any expiry -- it required a decayed effective_strength above 80 percent, not mere elapsed time. 204-CLASSIC-SYNTHESIS.md ruling (c) confirms the current signalIsWorthKeeping gate (REDIRECT type, or reinforced at least once) is likewise never solely because time elapsed, matching Classic's direction; TestExpiringAThrowawayNoteKeepsNothing proves an unreinforced, non-REDIRECT note promotes nothing on expiry. No Phase 204 plan re-derived the current gate against Classic's exact 80-percent-effective-strength threshold value -- the equivalence proven here is qualitative direction (never solely on elapsed time), not a verified numeric match; this precision gap is carried forward as a named limitation rather than silently closed.

Classic changelog-append and changelog-collect-plan-data evidence retained in 204-CLASSIC-HISTORICAL-EVIDENCE.md; collectChangelogEntriesFromLedger is a pure, idempotent derived view over the durable episode ledger (recordEpisodeOutcome/readEpisodeLedger), replacing separately-written changelog collection with an append-only episode-outcome event stream and a generated view, per ruling (f)'s durable-rollup-beside-the-live-bus design.

Classic .aether/data/build/phase-N/outcome.md evidence retained in 204-CLASSIC-HISTORICAL-EVIDENCE.md; renderEpisodeOutcomeSummary is a pure, idempotent derived view generated from the immutable durable episode ledger rather than a second, separately-written source of truth, per SYN-204-04's disposition.
